flags.message: The 46-page petition is marked empty_text=true and ocr_derived=false; petition.txt contains only whitespace and no questions-presented text was provisioned. Stakes are explicitly null rather than inferred from the caption; readable petition text or OCR would materially improve this cell.

The frozen distribution_count=1 appears to count the September 9 distribution for the September 28 conference on linked sealing motion 26M22, granted October 5, before this petition was docketed October 7. The distribution-stage cell has null cutoff/cut_kind. This may be a motion distribution misattributed to the cert moment; it is not a known cert outcome. I retain the supplied baseline band/count and predict a high count increment because the next entry may be the first substantive cert distribution, not a true relist.
